Rio Grande was supposed to be a modern 3D remake of River Raid, an 8-bit classics from Activision.

It was never finished and the team decided to work on the project codenamed [[Poseidon]] instead. <!-- but you can download Rio Grande early prototype from {{Link|link= ftp://www.flashpoint1985.com/flashpoint/demos/1996_Rio_Grande.zip}} -->
